recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 PAS 染色下，造血組織中穿插著洋紅色、寬度一致、有分隔的平行壁菌絲，並呈銳角分枝，符合侵襲性麴菌症（invasive aspergillosis）。
features: PAS-positive (magenta) fungal hyphae infiltrating hematopoietic marrow
Hyphae with parallel walls, uniform narrow width and visible septa
Scattered small round PAS-positive structures possibly representing conidia or cross-sectioned hyphae
Background cellular marrow with a megakaryocyte and fat spaces; brown pigment granules present
describe_en: PAS-stained bone marrow section shows cellular hematopoietic marrow infiltrated by numerous PAS-positive fungal hyphae with parallel walls, uniform width, regular septation and acute-angle branching. Occasional small round PAS-positive profiles may represent conidia or cross-sectioned hyphae. A megakaryocyte and fat spaces are present, and a granulomatous reaction is not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with invasive aspergillosis involving the bone marrow; culture or molecular confirmation of species is recommended.

ddx.vs: Mucorales hyphae are broad, ribbon-like and pauciseptate with right-angle branching and often stain weakly with PAS/GMS.
These hyaline septate molds are morphologically similar in tissue, so culture, PCR or specific immunohistochemistry is required.
Candida shows constrictions at septa (sausage links) with admixed budding yeasts rather than parallel-walled true hyphae.
